messages:
elaine-eng: Heads-up: Im heading to Montreal for ~6 weeks (Nov 10 -> Dec 22) to be with family and do focused work. Planning ~30-35 hrs/wk. Do I need to change home base? What happens to WFH stipend and healthcare while Im in Canada?

ron-peopleops: Short answer: keep your legal home base if this is temporary. WFH stipend flows monthly; we dont usually pause for short trips unless requested. Please fill the temporary-remote form and tag @ron-peopleops.

mike-payroll: FYI Canada visits can affect provincial withholding if you set up local banking or get paid locally. If you keep US bank and homebase unchanged, payroll remains the same. We will track days and notify if the 30-day rolling threshold is hit.

anya-legal: Note: cross-border healthcare is tricky. Quebecs public health may not cover short-term visitors; check your plans. Also avoid signing any documentation that looks like local employment. No hiring or contractor work locally without legal sign-off.

benefits-bot: Benefits reminder: verify in-network coverage and carry a copy of insurance card. Save receipts for out-of-network care. Telemedicine options might work but check roaming rules.

elaine-eng: Thanks. Ill submit the form and keep US bank. Any issues with shipping my laptop to a Canadian address?

ron-peopleops: Laptop shipping is allowed. Open an ops ticket so we can record asset location and confirm customs paperwork if needed. Enjoy the family time!
